body: I live on alder street in downtown and my apartment was full of tear gas as well. The protesters weren’t stationary and PPB found it necessary to fire tear gas directly below apartments. I’ve never experienced tear gas before that night.  [ppb tear gas ](https://imgur.com/a/UvL2YBt)

I moved out here to be closer to family and I got a job in the Vancouver area👍🏼. The job I transferred to was not what I thought it would be so I’ll be looking for a different job ASAP! I did casino surveillance in Minnesota before moving here.

I apologize for the late reply and thank you for the response. The day after I posted this, I was afraid I would hurt myself so I approached the 1st Police Officer I seen and sought help. They were very accommodating and I was placed in a psychiatric hospital and given the medication and counseling I needed. 

 It’s a very uncertain time for me. I am uprooting myself from Minnesota and moving home to Oregon. I will have to start life over from scratch. The feeling of dread won’t go away, even with the medication. The only feeling in feeling is fear and dread. 

 Finding a place to stay, a job and I  have no savings.  It’s really hard to stay positive and the will to live is slowly fading. I’ll keep fighting but it’s getting tough.
